rule: Preservation, structural inspection, and semantic authority are distinct capabilities. Unsupported semantics may remain exact bytes, but they never enter canonical fold, admission, or execution.

read.meaning: All material required by the selected reader profile is structurally and semantically understood.

read-degraded.meaning: The reader completed only its declared bounded operation and reports that semantic verification is incomplete.

preserve-only.meaning: Exact well-formed bytes may be retained or copied, but no semantic claim may be folded or admitted.

migration-required.meaning: A compatible reader or explicit receipt-bearing migration is required before this semantic operation may continue.

reject.meaning: Structural corruption or missing required material prevents even the selected bounded operation.

capabilities.meaning: Retain or copy exact source bytes without interpreting unknown layouts.
Report known structure and unknown inventory without claiming complete semantics.
Verify framing, byte ranges, checksums, and named roots that the reader understands.
Verify every meaning-bearing item required by the selected semantic scope.
Derive canonical state only from records whose exact schema and root protocols are supported.
Admit authority only after complete required semantic verification.
Execute behavior only from admitted, completely understood authority.

requires: the source byte range is bounded
all required framing and exact byte ranges are available
all selected checksum algorithms are supported
every meaning-bearing record in scope has a supported schema
every identity-bearing root in scope has a supported protocol
semantic verification completed for every folded record
unknown records remain outside the fold
canonical fold completed without unknown semantic inputs
all required declarations and admission proofs are present
all execution-required material is semantically understood

errorDictionary.meaning: A well-formed carrier type is not understood by this reader.
errorDictionary.next: Preserve exact bytes and use a compatible reader before semantic fold or admission.

errorDictionary.meaning: A well-formed payload or record names a schema this reader does not understand.
errorDictionary.next: Preserve exact bytes and obtain the exact schema or a compatible reader.

errorDictionary.meaning: An identity-bearing root uses a protocol this reader cannot reproduce.
errorDictionary.next: Use a compatible reader or an explicit receipt-bearing migration.

errorDictionary.meaning: The required container or record framing is malformed or truncated.
errorDictionary.next: Reject the operation and retain the source bytes for diagnosis.

errorDictionary.meaning: Material required by the selected reader profile is absent.
errorDictionary.next: Fetch or restore the exact required material; do not infer it.

errorDictionary.meaning: Structural verification completed but the required semantic scope is incomplete.
errorDictionary.next: Report degraded or migration-required according to the selected reader profile.
